publicReferenceFlow: Issue two actual authenticated annual Planner references from explicit synthetic raw records.
Human selects the January comparison through review-agenda; review-preview returns the admitted ReviewDraft.
Human preserves those exact sections through review-preserve, obtaining the public PreservedReview id/version.
Create the case only after both selections exist; its objective explicitly contains the human-selected public preservedReviewRef and reviewSelection.
Prepare the two existing closed input schemas through the installed workbench HTTP route. No field is added to ExecutiveReviewInput or MeetingMaterialInput.
With a real available model, require Session execution, SkillLoadReceipt, exact input/result digests and actual review/report/artifact tool results.
Download the artifactRef returned by that completed native report call, then consume the actual contribution through WP07 review-contribution and reopen it after host reload.

executive.output: DecisionBrief remains closed; generated report stays an auxiliary Session tool result, outside orderedResultRefs/runRef/resultRef.

meeting.output: MeetingMaterialProposal equals the actual native report result; artifact evidence equals its real artifact_get result.

nativeAssertions.receipts: Real completed Session messages in ascending order; callIds already bound by the shared harness; run/session/principal/call/input/result checks retained.
nativeAssertions.artifactDataFlow: The report assistant message must precede the artifact_get assistant message. A UI artifact never substitutes for the actual native result.
nativeAssertions.previewParity: Native review_prepare must equal the actual UI preview and preserve the selected review sections, evidence set and producer gaps.
nativeAssertions.docxParity: For each selected section and occurrence, compare all three rendered cells: captured id/value or unavailable/unit/currency; selected period; actual source refIds. Check headings/order and the full44-ID multiset, with38 distinct identities.
nativeAssertions.stateLimit: The renderer has no separate evidenceState column. Null-to-unavailable is checked; no nonexistent state column is claimed.

consumerMap.name: WP07 report generation and authorized artifact read
consumerMap.nativeBranch: Requires native tool results and receipts; not a replay with synthetic bindings.

consumerMap.name: WP07 report download
consumerMap.nativeBranch: Uses the artifactRef returned by the completed native report call; checks bytes and all captured cells.
consumerMap.noModelBranch: Uses the separately labeled UI artifact; no native attribution.

consumerMap.name: WP07 C11 contribution
consumerMap.nativeBranch: Exact output digest; Meeting review/artifact links; DecisionBrief remains strict with no routine or report inserted as a routine result.
consumerMap.noModelBranch: Not called because no real contribution exists.

consumerMap.name: Durable reopening
consumerMap.entry: Real host reopen, review-read, Meeting input, Session audit, contribution/output and artifact download
consumerMap.limit: Does not recreate an ephemeral agenda or claim a new Executive prepare after reload.

knownUnresolvedBoundaries: Provider availability and positive native execution remain unobserved for this new test. Empty installed catalog records availability and actual UI work only.
C07 routine catalog/admission/run/status/result obligations remain distinct and are not exercised as successful routine execution.
No autonomous discovery of public agenda/preservedReviewRef is claimed; the human explicitly selects both through supported public actions.
The existing Executive monthly historical-source mutation403 is separate and its strict assertion remains unchanged in its original test.
A new Executive preparation after host reload still requires a valid current agenda; durable existing output consumption does not prove agenda reconstruction.

AM02 includes authority/refusal requirements beyond this new positive path. Written driver and static review do not accept any AM02 route without the exact hosted execution and applicable refusal evidence.
